requirement: The current sampling mechanism shall support a measurement range of -300A to +300A with a precision of 0.1A and an accuracy within ±3.5A
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0001_D.1
      Title: Verify current sampling mechanism measurement range
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Boundary Value Analysis
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Apply input current signals at the following values: -300.0A, -299.9A, 0.0A, +299.9A, +300.0A.
          2. Confirm that the system successfully samples and reports each value without error or saturation.
        Fail: |
          - The system fails to sample or report any of the boundary or near-boundary test points.
          - The system reports an out-of-range error for any input within [-300.0A, +300.0A].
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0001_D.2
      Title: Verify current sampling mechanism precision
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Positive Testing
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Apply a stable input current of 150.0A.
          2. Record 10 consecutive sampled values.
          3. Confirm that all reported values are increments of 0.1A (e.g., 149.9A, 150.0A, 150.1A) and that the resolution is not coarser than 0.1A.
        Fail: |
          - Any sampled value is reported with a resolution worse than 0.1A (e.g., 150A, 150.5A).
          - The system rounds or truncates values in a manner inconsistent with 0.1A precision.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0001_D.3
      Title: Verify current sampling mechanism accuracy
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Equivalence Class Testing
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Apply calibrated input currents at -250.0A, -100.0A, 0.0A, +100.0A, +250.0A.
          2. For each input, record the system’s reported value.
          3. Confirm that the absolute difference between the applied current and the reported value is ≤ 3.5A for all test points.
        Fail: |
          - Any reported value deviates from the applied current by more than ±3.5A.

requirement: "The ECU shall revert to full communication (enable both Tx and Rx) upon receipt of an '<SIG>' command, and this re-enablement shall be completed within 10 ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0006_D_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Re-enablement Latency on Command Trigger (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Place ECU in restricted communication state (e.g., disabled Tx/Rx).
          2. Send UDS '<SIG>' command (Time T0).
          3. Measure Time T1 when periodic message transmission resumes.
          4. Verify Delta (T1 - T0) <= 10 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Communication not restored within 10 ms.

requirement: "The ECU shall revert to full communication (enable both Tx and Rx) after any hardware or software reset, and this re-enablement shall be completed within 100 ms of the ECU completing its initialization sequence
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0006_D_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Post-Reset Communication Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject a software reset (watchdog trigger) while communication is restricted.
          2. Measure time from the 'ECU Initialization Complete' signal (T0) to the first transmitted periodic message (T1).
          3. Verify Delta (T1 - T0) ≤ 100 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Communication remains restricted or is not initiated within 100 ms post-initialization.

requirement: "The system shall operate in 'Normal Mode' (Full Functionality, All DTCs Active) while the KL30 supply voltage is within the range of [9V, 16V] (inclusive)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.012_C_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Normal Mode in valid voltage range (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Apply stable KL30 = 9.0V.
          2. Verify system enters/maintains 'Normal Mode'.
          3. Apply stable KL30 = 16.0V.
          4. Verify system enters/maintains 'Normal Mode'.
          5. Apply stable KL30 = 12.5V.
          6. Verify system maintains 'Normal Mode'.
        Fail: |
          - System drops out of 'Normal Mode' at 9.0V, 16.0V, or 12.5V.

requirement: "The system shall re-enter 'Normal Mode' from an abnormal voltage state only after the KL30 voltage has returned to the valid range [9V, 16V] and remained stable for at least 200ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.012_C_B.1"
      Title: "Verify 200ms <SIG> for voltage recovery"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Force system to 'Overvoltage' (>16V).
          2. Step KL30 voltage back to 12.5V (Valid).
          3. Monitor 'Normal Mode' status.
          4. Confirm system does NOT enter 'Normal Mode' immediately (< 200ms).
          5. Confirm system enters 'Normal Mode' after 200ms (plus minimal processing delay, e.g., <20ms).
        Fail: |
          - System enters 'Normal Mode' in less than 200ms.
          - System fails to enter 'Normal Mode' after 200ms.

requirement: "The system shall transition from Pre-Sleep Mode to Sleep Mode if and only if the waiting period <SIG_182> (500 ms) has elapsed without interruption
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0017_A_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Transition Time <SIG> (Positive BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Place the system in Pre-Sleep Mode (Time $<SIG_59>$).
          2. Measure the time interval to the moment the system enters Sleep Mode (Time $<SIG_60>$).
          3. Verify the measured time interval ($<SIG_60> - <SIG_59>$) is within the acceptable tolerance window: $[490\text{ms}, 510\text{ms}]$ ($\pm 10\text{ms}$ of $500\text{ms}$ target).
        Fail: |
          - Measured transition time is $< 490\text{ms}$ (Premature Sleep).
          - Measured transition time is $> 510\text{ms}$ (Timeout error).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0017_A_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Persistence of Pre-Sleep (Negative BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Place the system in Pre-Sleep Mode.
          2. Monitor system state continuously.
          3. Confirm that the system remains in Pre-Sleep Mode for the entire duration up to the $490\text{ms}$ mark.
        Fail: |
          - System transitions to Sleep Mode before $490\text{ms}$ has elapsed.

requirement: "The system shall immediately cancel the transition to Sleep Mode and return to Normal Operation State if a valid Network Wakeup Event is detected during the <SIG_182> period
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0017_A_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Interruption of Transition (Negative Robustness)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Place the system in Pre-Sleep Mode.
          2. At $250\text{ms}$ (mid-point of the timer), inject a valid Network Wakeup Event (e.g., reception of an NM PDU).
          3. Verify the system aborts the Sleep transition and immediately returns to Normal Operation State.
          4. Verify the system does NOT enter Sleep Mode.
        Fail: |
          - System enters Sleep Mode despite the Wakeup Event.
          - System hangs or enters an undefined state.

requirement: "The system shall inhibit the transmission of Application-level CAN/LIN messages until the corresponding Signal Source Drivers (e.g., ADC, PWM, SPI) have completed their first valid measurement cycle (<SIG_24> = TRUE)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.022.1"
      Title: "Verify Transmission <SIG> Before Data Readiness"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger ECU Wake-up.
          2. Monitor Bus: Confirm NO Application messages are sent during the Driver Initialization window (t < <SIG_25>).
        Fail: |
          - Messages are transmitted containing uninitialized RAM data.

requirement: "Within the <SIG_189> phase, once transmission commences, the system shall set all signals to their first captured physical value. If a specific signal source is still unavailable, the corresponding '<SIG_190>' bit shall be set to 'INIT' (0x01) and the data field shall be set to the defined <SIG_195>
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.022.2"
      Title: "Verify Signal Validity and Quality Bits Post-Wakeup"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Capture the first transmitted frame of message '<SIG_191>'.
          2. Verify signal '<SIG_41>' is within [0, 5] km/h (<SIG>) OR <SIG_190> = INIT.
          3. Confirm no signals contain 'Deadly' values (e.g., 0xFF if not defined as Invalid).
        Fail: |
          - First frame contains random RAM noise or unmapped default values.

requirement: "Upon entering the 'Repeat' State, the system shall reset the 'Condition9' variable to its default value (0x00)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.027.1"
      Title: "Verify Condition9 Reset on State Entry (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set 'Condition9' to a non-zero value (e.g., 0xFF).
          2. Trigger transition to 'Repeat' State.
          3. Read 'Condition9' immediately upon state entry.
          4. Verify 'Condition9' == 0x00.
        Fail: |
          - 'Condition9' retains the old value or is set to an incorrect value.

requirement: "The system shall complete the reset of 'Condition9' (defined in SYRS.0027_B_A) within 5 ms of the 'Repeat' State entry signal being processed
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.027.2"
      Title: "Verify Reset Latency and Robustness (Performance/Stress)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Perform rapid state transitions (every $10\text{ms}$) into 'Repeat' State.
          2. For each transition, measure the time between state entry and 'Condition9' reflecting 0x00.
          3. Verify the reset occurs within $\le 5\text{ms}$ across 100 consecutive trials.
        Fail: |
          - Reset latency exceeds $5\text{ms}$.
          - Variable fails to clear during high-frequency transitions.

requirement: "The DEM shall implement a Counter-Based <SIG> Strategy for CRC Errors. 1. Condition: When a valid message with correct CRC is received. 2. Action: The internal <SIG> Counter shall be decremented (or reset based on step-size configuration). 3. Threshold: When 3 consecutive valid messages are processed (<SIG_223> = 3), the DEM shall reset the '<SIG>' bit (Bit 0) of the associated <SIG> to 0
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0031_B_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Bit 0 Reset Logic (Heal Strategy)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "State Transition Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Set CRC DTC Status Bit 0 = 1 (<SIG>).
          2. Inject 2 valid CRC frames. Verify Bit 0 remains 1.
          3. Inject 3rd valid CRC frame.
          4. Verify Bit 0 transitions to 0.
          5. Verify Bit 3 (<SIG>) remains 1 (History).
        Fail: |
          - Bit 0 resets before 3rd frame.
          - Bit 0 remains 1 after 3rd frame.

requirement: "The system shall set and maintain all associated MOSFETs in the electrically 'Closed' (non-conducting / Safe) state within 100 ms of detecting a single channel fault

"The System shall disable the '<SIG_246>' function within [<SIG_247>] if the count of valid voltage samples is less than 3. A sample is considered 'Valid' only if it is not currently flagged with a 'Short-Circuit' or 'Open-Circuit' fault
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0035_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Offset Detection Suppression (Boundary: 2 Samples)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Initialize system with 4 voltage input channels.
          2. Inject 'Short-Circuit' fault on Channel 1 and 'Open-Circuit' fault on Channel 2.
          3. Confirm Channel 3 and Channel 4 remain 'Valid'.
          4. Monitor the internal '<SIG_248>' flag via measurement tool (e.g., CANape).
          5. Verify the flag transitions to 'Disabled' (FALSE) within one diagnostic cycle.
          6. Verify no '<SIG_363>' is reported even if an offset is injected into remaining valid channels.
        Fail: |
          - '<SIG_246>' remains 'Enabled' with only 2 valid samples.
          - System reports an offset fault based on an insufficient number of samples.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0035_B.2"
      Title: "Verify Offset Detection Activation (Boundary: 3 Samples)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Initialize system with 4 voltage input channels.
          2. Inject 'Short-Circuit' fault on only 1 channel, leaving 3 channels 'Valid'.
          3. Verify the '<SIG_248>' flag is 'Enabled' (TRUE).
          4. Inject an offset exceeding the detection threshold into one of the 3 valid channels.
          5. Verify the system detects and reports the '<SIG_363>' within the specified time.
        Fail: |
          - '<SIG_246>' is incorrectly disabled when 3 valid samples are available.
          - Offset fault is not detected despite having 3 valid samples.

requirement: "Upon confirmation of the System Fault (SYRS.0035_E_A), the System shall execute the Safe State transition within 20ms: 1. <SIG> Action: Command all relevant MOSFETs to the OFF State (High Impedance/Non-conducting). 2. <SIG>: Prevent any re-activation of MOSFETs until a Power-On-Reset (POR) occurs
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0035_E_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Safe State Transition (MOSFET OFF)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject Offset Faults on 3 channels > 50ms.
          2. Monitor Gate-Source Voltage (Vgs) of MOSFETs.
          3. Verify Vgs drops to 0V (OFF state) within 20ms of fault confirmation.
          4. Verify Current = 0A.
        Fail: |
          - MOSFET remains ON or enters undefined state.

requirement: "If the system enters '<SIG_30>' (Voltage > 18.0V per <SIG_282>), the ECU SHALL immediately suspend all CAN bus transmissions (Bus-Off mode) to prevent high-voltage signal interference
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.058.1"
      Title: "Verify Mandatory CAN Suspension in Over-Voltage Init"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Apply 19.0V to system power pins.
          2. Verify system enters '<SIG_30>'.
          3. Monitor CAN bus for 5.0s: Confirm total absence of frames from the DUT.
        Fail: |
          - Any CAN frames are detected while in Over-Voltage state.

requirement: "Upon exiting '<SIG_30>' and returning to '<SIG_31>', the system SHALL resume periodic CAN transmissions within 100 ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.058.2"
      Title: "Verify Communication Re-initialization Latency"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Transition voltage from 19.0V to 13.5V (Nominal).
          2. Measure time <SIG_32> until the first valid SOF on CAN.
          3. Verify <SIG_32> <= 100 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Re-initialization delay exceeds 100 ms or message format is invalid.

requirement: "Upon power-on, the system shall enter the 'Operating Voltage Mode' within 1 second if the battery voltage is strictly between the calibrated thresholds <SIG_183> and <SIG_184>
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.059_A.1"
      Title: "Verify entry into Operating Voltage Mode (Positive BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Configure <SIG_183> = 9V, <SIG_184> = 16V (example values).
          2. Power on system with Bat = 9.1V (Just above Min).
          3. Verify system enters 'Operating Voltage Mode' within 1 second.
          4. Power on system with Bat = 15.9V (Just below Max).
          5. Verify system enters 'Operating Voltage Mode' within 1 second.
        Fail: |
          - System fails to enter mode within 1s.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.059_A.2"
      Title: "Verify rejection of invalid voltage (Negative BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Power on system with Bat = 9.0V (Exact Min).
          2. Verify system does NOT enter 'Operating Voltage Mode'.
          3. Power on system with Bat = 16.0V (Exact Max).
          4. Verify system does NOT enter 'Operating Voltage Mode'.
        Fail: |
          - System enters 'Operating Voltage Mode' at boundary values.

requirement: 'The ECU shall support the Network Transport Protocol as defined in ISO 15765-2
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0064.1"
      Title: "Verify RX (ECU as Receiver) reassembly of multi-frame messages"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Send a 20-byte payload from tester to ECU.
          2. Confirm ECU receives and correctly reassembles the payload using ISO 15765-2 flow control (FC) and consecutive frame (CF) handling.
          3. Validate that the reassembled payload matches the original payload.
        Fail: |
          - ECU fails to respond with a Flow Control frame.
          - Reassembled payload does not match original payload.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0064.2"
      Title: "Verify RX (ECU as Receiver) boundary payload sizes"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. (SF) Transmit 7-byte payload; verify ECU processes it.
          2. (MF Min) Transmit 8-byte payload; verify correct reassembly.
          3. (MF Max) Transmit 4095-byte payload; verify correct reassembly.
          4. (Negative) Transmit 4096-byte payload; verify ECU rejects it (e.g., sends FC 'Overflow' or ignores).
        Fail: |
          - 7-byte (SF) or 8-byte (MF) messages are misinterpreted.
          - Payload of 4096 bytes is accepted.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0064.3"
      Title: "Verify RX (ECU as Receiver) robustness against malformed frames"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a First Frame with an invalid PCI.
          2. Send Consecutive Frames with sequence number errors (e.g., skipped '1, 3...').
          3. Verify ECU discards the malformed transmission and does not process corrupted data.
        Fail: |
          - ECU processes data from a transmission with sequence number errors.
          - ECU crashes or resets.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0064.4"
      Title: "Verify TX (ECU as Sender) segmentation and flow control handling"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger the ECU to send a multi-frame message (e.g., a 20-byte diagnostic response).
          2. Verify ECU transmits a valid First Frame (FF).
          3. Tester responds with a valid Flow Control (FC) frame (e.g., BS=5, STmin=10ms).
          4. Verify ECU transmits the remaining Consecutive Frames (CFs) correctly, adhering to the BS and STmin parameters.
        Fail: |
          - ECU does not transmit a valid FF.
          - ECU ignores the tester's FC frame (e.g., sends more than 5 frames or faster than 10ms).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0064.5"
      Title: "Verify TX (ECU as Sender) robustness against invalid Flow Control"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger the ECU to send a 20-byte response.
          2. Verify ECU transmits a valid FF.
          3. Tester responds with an FC frame with <SIG>='Wait' (FC.FS=1).
          4. Verify ECU pauses transmission.
          5. Tester responds with an FC frame with <SIG>='Overflow' (FC.FS=2).
          6. Verify ECU aborts the transmission.
        Fail: |
          - ECU continues to send CFs despite an FC 'Wait' or 'Overflow' command.
          - ECU crashes or enters an undefined state.

requirement: "The CAN Transport Layer (ISO 15765-2) shall initiate the transmission of a Flow Control (FC) frame within the <SIG_27> timeout period upon successful reception of a First Frame (FF) or the completion of a Block (last CF). 1. Maximum Latency (<SIG_27>): 10.0 ms; 2. Timing Reference: From end of data reception to CAN controller Transmit Request
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0067.1"
      Title: "Verify <SIG_27> Timing for FS=CTS (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject a valid FF.
          2. Measure interval <SIG_28> (End of FF to SOF of FC). 
          3. Verify <SIG_28> <= 10.0 ms.
        Fail: |
          - <SIG_28> exceeds 10.0 ms.

requirement: "If system resources are insufficient to process the incoming segment at the time of <SIG_27> expiration, the system shall transmit a Flow Control frame with Flow Status set to 'WAIT' (FS=1) and reset the <SIG_27> timer
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0067.2"
      Title: "Verify FS=WAIT Behavior under Resource Stress"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Stress Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Simulate high CPU load/buffer full condition.
          2. Inject valid FF.
          3. Verify FC (FS=1) is transmitted within 10 ms.
        Fail: |
          - System fails to send FC or sends FS=0 despite resource depletion.

requirement: "The CAN Transport Layer (ISO 15765-2) shall parse and apply the STmin (Minimum Separation Time) from received Flow Control frames within the following ranges: 1. 0x00 - 0x7F: 0 ms to 127 ms; 2. 0xF1 - 0xF9: 100 μs to 900 μs. The transmission of subsequent Consecutive Frames (CF) shall respect the applied STmin with a timing accuracy of +1ms / -0ms (Upper-bound jitter)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0068.1"
      Title: "Verify Sub-millisecond STmin Acceptance (0xF5 = 500μs)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Tester sends FC with STmin = 0xF5 (500 μs).
          2. Measure ECU CF inter-frame gap. Verify gap is within [500 μs, 1500 μs].
        Fail: |
          - ECU fails to parse microsecond range or gap exceeds 1500 μs.

requirement: "If the ECU receives a Flow Control frame with an invalid STmin value (reserved ranges 0x80-0xF0 or 0xFA-0xFF), the system shall: 1. Continue transmission using the maximum allowed separation time of 127 ms; 2. NOT abort the current transport protocol session
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0068.2"
      Title: "Verify Robustness for Invalid STmin (0x80)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Tester sends FC with STmin = 0x80.
          2. Verify ECU continues sending CF with inter-frame gap >= 127 ms.
        Fail: |
          - ECU aborts session or uses a separation time < 127 ms.

requirement: "The system shall configure the ISO 15765-2 Flow Control (FC) parameters based on the active operational mode to match internal processing capabilities: 1. In 'Application Mode': STmin = 10 ms (0x0A), BS = 8; 2. In 'Boot Mode': STmin = 50 ms (0x32), BS = 1; 3. In 'Service Mode': STmin = 0 ms (0x00), BS = 0 (Continuous)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0069.1"
      Title: "Verify Mode-Dependent STmin and BS Mapping"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set ECU to Application Mode. Trigger multi-frame RX. Verify FC: STmin=0x0A, BS=0x08.
          2. Set ECU to Boot Mode. Trigger multi-frame RX. Verify FC: STmin=0x32, BS=0x01.
        Fail: |
          - STmin or BS values do not match the specific mode's requirements.

requirement: "The STmin value requested by the ECU shall be configurable via the Calibration Parameter '<SIG_34>' to support future processing optimization without software logic changes
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0069.2"
      Title: "Verify STmin Parameterization via Calibration"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Modify '<SIG_34>' to 5 ms (0x05) via XCP/Diagnostic service.
          2. Capture FC frame in Application Mode.
          3. Verify STmin = 0x05.
        Fail: |
          - ECU ignores the calibrated value and uses a hard-coded 10 ms.

requirement: "The CAN Transport Layer (ISO 15765-2) shall initiate the transmission of the FIRST Consecutive Frame (CF Index 1) within the <SIG_196> timeout period after a positive confirmation of the received Flow Control (FC) frame. 1. Maximum Latency (<SIG_196>): 10.0 ms; 2. The STmin parameter shall NOT be applied to the interval between FC and the first CF
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0070.1"
      Title: "Verify <SIG_196> Latency Regardless of STmin Value"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Tester sends FC with STmin = 50 ms.
          2. ECU transmits CF Index 1. 
          3. Measure interval <SIG_197> (FC End to CF 1 SOF). 
          4. Verify <SIG_197> <= 10.0 ms (ignoring the 50ms STmin).
        Fail: |
          - <SIG_197> exceeds 10.0 ms or the ECU mistakenly applies STmin to the first CF.

requirement: "The system shall apply the STmin (Separation Time) constraints only to subsequent Consecutive Frames (from CF Index 1 to CF Index 2, and so on), as defined in ISO 15765-2
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0070.2"
      Title: "Verify STmin Enforcement for Subsequent CFs"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Measure gap between CF 1 and CF 2.
          2. Verify Gap >= <SIG_26> AND Gap <= (<SIG_26> + 2ms Jitter).
        Fail: |
          - Inter-frame gap is less than the requested STmin.

requirement: "In 'Application Mode', the CAN Transport Layer (ISO 15765-2) shall configure the Flow Control (FC) parameters for segmented reception as follows: 1. Block Size (BS) = 8; 2. Separation Time (STmin) = 10 ms (or per <SIG_12>); 3. Flow Status (FS) = 0 (Continue To Send)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0072.1"
      Title: "Verify ISO 15765-2 Flow Control Parameter Implementation (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. ECU in Application Mode. Initiate multi-frame reception (e.g., ReadDataByIdentifier).
          2. Monitor ECU's Flow Control (FC) frame.
          3. Confirm: Byte 1 (FS) = 0x00, Byte 2 (BS) = 0x08, Byte 3 (STmin) = 0x0A.
        Fail: |
          - Any FC parameter (BS, STmin, FS) deviates from the required values.

requirement: "The system shall maintain the configured Block Size (BS=8) during high bus-load conditions (>= 70%) and during concurrent multi-channel diagnostic sessions

      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0072.2"
      Title: "Verify BS Consistency Under Stress Conditions (Robustness)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Stress Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject 70% background CAN traffic.
          2. Perform large data transfer (e.g., TransferData $36).
          3. Verify BS remains exactly 8 across all FC frames.
        Fail: |
          - BS value jitters or resets to default (0) under stress.

requirement: The ECU shall abort the current transmission session if the transmission of any CAN frame (Protocol Data Unit) takes longer than 2000 ms (<SIG_1> timeout) due to bus congestion
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0075.1
      Title: Verification of <SIG_1> timeout handling under bus congestion
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Boundary Value Analysis
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1.  Simulate a CAN bus congestion scenario such that the transmission
          	 time of a single CAN frame exceeds 2000 ms.

          2.  Monitor the ECU''s behavior during the transmission attempt.

          3.  Confirm that the ECU aborts the current transmission session within
          	 10 ms after the 2000 ms threshold is exceeded.

          '
        Fail: '-    The ECU does not abort the transmission session within 2010 ms
          	 after the start of the CAN frame transmission.

          -    The ECU continues attempting to transmit the same frame beyond the timeout
          	 without aborting.

          '
  - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0075.2
      Title: Verification that transmission proceeds normally when frame completes
        within <SIG_1> timeout
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Positive Testing
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1.  Transmit a CAN frame under normal bus load conditions where the
          	 transmission completes in less than 2000 ms (e.g., 1999 ms).

          2.  Verify that the ECU successfully completes the transmission session
          	 and does not abort.

          '
        Fail: '-    The ECU aborts the transmission session despite the frame being
          	 transmitted within 2000 ms.

          -    The ECU exhibits undefined or erroneous behavior during or after successful
          	 transmission.'

requirement: "The system shall implement the ISO 15765-2 Network Layer timeout <SIG_14> (Time until reception of Flow Control). 1. The parameter value <SIG_14> shall be configurable via <SIG_15> (Default: 2000 ms). 2. The measurement resolution shall be <= 10 ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0076.1"
      Title: "Verify <SIG_14> Parameter Configuration and Precision"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Configure <SIG_14> = 2000 ms.
          2. Trigger FF transmission.
          3. Verify timer starts exactly at FF confirmation (<SIG_1> end).
        Fail: |
          - Timer resolution exceeds 10 ms or fails to map to configuration.

requirement: "If the <SIG_14> timer expires before a valid Flow Control (FC) frame is received, the Network Layer shall: 1. Abort the current segmented transmission; 2. Issue an <SIG_16> = <SIG_17> notification to the Upper Layer (Service Interface)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0076.2"
      Title: "Verify Transmission Abort and Notification (Fault Injection)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. FF sent; No FC injected. 
          2. Verify further CF (Consecutive Frames) are inhibited.
          3. Measure Abort time <SIG_18>: Confirm 2000 ms <= <SIG_18> <= 2010 ms (includes resolution).
          4. Verify Upper Layer receives 'Timeout' notification.
        Fail: |
          - Transmission continues post-timeout or notification is missing.

requirement: "The ECU shall abort the transmission if a Flow Control (FC) frame is not received within 2000 ms (<SIG_14> timeout) after transmitting the last Consecutive Frame (CF) of a transmission block
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0077.1"
      Title: "Verify transmission aborts (BVA Negative: Timeout Occurs)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis (Negative)"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a multi-frame ECU transmission.
          2. After the ECU sends the last CF of a block, the tester (receiver) sends no FC frame.
          3. Verify the ECU aborts the transmission (e.g., TP state returns to Idle).
          4. Verify the time from (End of CF) to (Abort) is 2000 ms (within tolerance, e.g., ± 10ms).
        Fail: |
          - ECU continues transmission attempts > 2010 ms.
          - ECU aborts transmission < 1990 ms.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0077.2"
      Title: "Verify transmission continues (BVA Positive: Just-in-Time FC)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis (Positive)"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a multi-frame ECU transmission.
          2. After the ECU sends the last CF of a block, the tester sends a valid FC frame just before the timeout (e.g., at 1990 ms).
          3. Verify the ECU accepts the FC frame and continues the transmission correctly (does not abort).
        Fail: |
          - The ECU aborts the transmission even after receiving a valid FC frame before the 2000ms timeout.

requirement: If the 'Radio/Media' button is detected as released (after <SIG>), the system shall set the CAN signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_287>' to FALSE (0x00)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYS.0087.1
    Title: Verification of CAN signal state after Radio/Media button release
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Positive Testing
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Simulate a valid press and subsequent release of the 'Radio/Media' button, ensuring the release is stable for at least the specified <SIG> duration (e.g., $\ge 10\text{ ms}$).
        2. Monitor the CAN signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_287>' on the designated CAN bus.
        3. Confirm that within $10\text{ ms}$ of the <SIG>d button release event, the signal value is set to $0x00$ (FALSE).
      Fail: |
        - The CAN signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_287>' does not transition to $0x00$ within $10\text{ ms}$ after the <SIG>d button release.
        - The signal remains at $0x01$ (TRUE) or enters an undefined/invalid state (not $0x00$ or $0x01$).
- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYS.0087.2
    Title: Boundary verification of <SIG> timing impact on signal output
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Boundary Value Analysis
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Apply a button release event with a duration equal to the minimum <SIG> threshold (e.g., exactly $10\text{ ms}$).
        2. Verify that the system recognizes this as a valid release and sets '<SIG_166>::<SIG_287>' to $0x00$ within $10\text{ ms}$.
        3. Apply a button release event with a duration just below the <SIG> threshold (e.g., $9.9\text{ ms}$).
        4. Verify that the system does NOT set the signal to $0x00$ (i.e., ignores the transient release).
      Fail: |
        - At the exact <SIG> threshold, the signal fails to transition to $0x00$.
        - Below the <SIG> threshold, the signal incorrectly transitions to $0x00$.

requirement: "If the 'Navi' button is detected as pressed (after <SIG>), the system shall set the CAN signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_169>' to TRUE (0x01)

- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0089_A.1"

      Method:

        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:

        Technique: "Negative Testing"

          1. Simulate electrical noise/transient press below the <SIG> threshold.
          2. Verify the '<SIG_169>' signal remains 0x00 (FALSE) throughout the event.
        Fail: |
          - The '<SIG_169>' signal is set to 0x01 due to noise or transient input.

requirement: "If the 'Tel' button is detected as released (after <SIG>), the system shall set the Update Bit signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_167>' to 1 in the immediate transmission frame
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0096_A_A.1"

        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:

          2. Verify '<SIG_167>' is set to 1 in the immediate transmission frame following the <SIG>d release.

          2. Verify '<SIG_167>' remains 0 in the immediate transmission frame.

requirement: "The system shall clear the Update Bit signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_167>' to 0 in the transmission frame immediately following the frame where the bit was set to 1

requirement: "If the 'OFF/Mute' button is detected as released (after <SIG>), the system shall set the Update Bit signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_168>' to 1 in the immediate transmission frame

requirement: "The system shall clear the Update Bit signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_168>' to 0 in the transmission frame immediately following the frame where the bit was set to 1

requirement: "Upon confirming the release of the 'OFF/Mute' button, the system shall set the signal '<SIG_166>::<SIG_168>' to the value 0 (Not Pressed)

- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0111_B_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Signal Reset on Button Release (Positive)"

requirement: The system shall confirm and report the 'Rain Onset' status within 5 seconds of the first raindrop impact that satisfies the detection threshold
golden_vc:

      VC_ID: VC_SYS.0130_B.1
      Title: Verify Rain Onset status is reported within 5 seconds after valid raindrop
        detection
      Method:
        Type: Dynamic
        Technique: Positive Testing
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1. Simulate a single raindrop impact that meets or exceeds the defined
          	 detection threshold (e.g., optical sensor signal ≥ X <SIG> or equivalent physical
          	 stimulus).

          2. Measure the time interval from the moment the valid raindrop impact is
          	 applied to the system until the ''Rain Onset'' status is reported on the
          	 vehicle network (e.g., via CAN message with defined signal state).

          3. Confirm the measured time interval is ≤ 5.0 seconds with a tolerance
          	 of ±10 ms.

        Fail: '- The ''Rain Onset'' status is not reported within 5.01 seconds.

          - The system reports an incorrect or undefined status.

          - No status is reported at all.

          '

      Title: Verify system does not report Rain Onset for sub-threshold raindrop impacts

      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1. Apply a simulated raindrop impact that is below the defined detection
          	 threshold (e.g., optical sensor signal < X <SIG>).

          2. Monitor the system output for a duration of at least 10 seconds.

          3. Confirm that the ''Rain Onset'' status is not reported during this period.

          '
        Fail: '- The ''Rain Onset'' status is reported despite the stimulus being

          - An ambiguous or partial status is reported.'

requirement: "The system shall confirm the 'Rain Cessation' status IF the detected precipitation intensity remains continuously below 0.1 mm/h (<SIG_109>) for $\ge$ 30.0 seconds. Any momentary breach of this threshold shall reset the stability timer to 0
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0131.1"
      Title: "Verify Rain Cessation Timing and Reset Logic (Positive/Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. (Stability): Maintain Rain < 0.1 mm/h for 30.1s. Verify 'Rain Cessation' is confirmed.
          2. (Reset): Maintain Rain < 0.1 mm/h for 29.5s, then pulse Rain > 0.1 mm/h for 0.1s. Verify 'Rain Cessation' is NOT confirmed at 30s.
          3. (Restart): Verify a new 30s continuous window is required after reset.
        Fail: |
          - Status reported before 30s or timer fails to reset on threshold breach.

requirement: "The system shall transmit the confirmed 'Rain Cessation' status on the vehicle bus within 100 ms of the 30.0-second stability threshold being reached
golden_vc:

        Fail: |

Fail-safe: If the speed signal is invalid/SNA, the system shall default the interval to 12.0 s

requirement: "When the Rain Sensor is Inactive (and NOT in fault or cranking states), the system shall set the LIN signal '<SIG_97>' to 0 (Wiper Off/Park) within 100 ms

requirement: "The system shall execute the signal setting defined in SYRS.0139_D_A within 100 ms of the condition being met
golden_vc:

requirement: "Under 'Night Condition' (< 50 lux), the system shall increase the target wiper activation frequency by a factor of 1.5 for the same detected rain intensity

requirement: "The system (as LIN Master) shall transmit the humidity and temperature messages using the exact cycle time defined for them in the valid LDF
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0205.1"
      Title: "Verify cycle time matches LDF (Test Case T1: 100ms)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Load a valid LDF specifying cycle time T1 = 100ms.
          2. Capture LIN messages.
          3. Verify the average cycle time is 100ms (e.g., ±5% tolerance) and jitter (individual cycles) is within spec (e.g., ±10% tolerance).
        Fail: |
          - Measured average cycle time is outside 100ms ± 5%.
          - Any single cycle deviates > 10% from 100ms.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0205.2"
      Title: "Verify cycle time is dynamic from LDF (Test Case T2: 500ms)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Load a valid LDF specifying cycle time T2 = 500ms.
          2. Capture LIN messages.
          3. Verify the average cycle time is 500ms (e.g., ±5% tolerance) and jitter is within spec (e.g., ±10% tolerance).
        Fail: |
          - Measured average cycle time is outside 500ms ± 5%.
          - System continues to use 100ms (from VC.1), proving the LDF value is not being read.

requirement: "Upon system wake-up, the Humidity Sensor algorithm shall set the 'Response Dynamic Factor' to 100% (No Filter) within 10 ms to ensure rapid initial measurement
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0207_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Factor Setting and Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger system wake-up event (Time T0).
          2. Monitor the 'Response Dynamic Factor' parameter (internal trace/XCP).
          3. Verify the parameter value transitions to exactly 100%.
          4. Verify the transition completes within 10 ms of T0.
        Fail: |
          - Factor value is not 100% within 10 ms.
          - Latency exceeds 10 ms.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0207_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Functional Outcome (No Filter Effect)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Induce a step change in humidity (e.g., 30% RH to 70% RH) immediately after system wake-up.
          2. Verify the output reading (first valid output frame) reflects the new humidity level with no temporal lag attributable to filtering (i.e., deviation from raw sensor reading is within sensor accuracy tolerance).
        Fail: |
          - Output shows evidence of filtering (e.g., value is smoothed or exhibits exponential lag).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0207_A.3"
      Title: "Verify Reversion to Filtered State (<SIG> Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. After the initial rapid measurement period (e.g., 500 ms), monitor the 'Response Dynamic Factor'.
          2. Verify the factor transitions from 100% to a nominal filtered value (e.g., 20% to 50%) as defined in the algorithm specification.
        Fail: |
          - The 'Response Dynamic Factor' remains at 100% indefinitely after the initial measurement window, risking unstable output.

requirement: If the measured solar irradiance is greater than or equal to (>=) 1200 W/m², the ECU shall transmit a clamped value of exactly 1200 W/m² on the LIN bus
golden_vc:

      Title: Verify clamping of solar irradiance output at upper limit under positive
        test condition

      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1. Simulate a solar irradiance input signal to the ECU that is greater
          	 than 1200 W/m² (e.g., 1300 W/m² ±1%).

          2. Monitor the value transmitted by the ECU on the LIN bus corresponding
          	 to solar irradiance.

          3. Confirm that the transmitted value is exactly 1200 W/m² with a tolerance
          	 of ±0.5 W/m².

        Fail: '- Transmitted LIN value is not within [1199.5, 1200.5] W/m² when input
          	 > 1200 W/m².

          '
  - VC_Item:

      Title: Verify exact clamping behavior at boundary threshold
      Method:

      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: '1. Simulate a solar irradiance input signal of exactly 1200.0 W/m²
          	 ±0.1%.

          2. Monitor the value transmitted on the LIN bus.

          3. Confirm that the transmitted value is exactly 1200.0 W/m² ±0.5 W/m².

          '
        Fail: '- Transmitted LIN value deviates outside [1199.5, 1200.5] W/m² when
          	 input is exactly 1200.0 W/m².'

requirement: If the measured solar irradiance is less than (<) 1200 W/m², the ECU shall transmit the measured value on the LIN bus (pass-through)

requirement: "The system's LIN interface shall transmit and receive using the LIN 2.0 frame format (Sync, PID, Data, Enhanced Checksum) at 19.2 kbit/s (±14% tolerance)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0217_A_1.1"
      Title: "Verify LIN 2.0 Frame Format and Baud Rate (Nominal)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Use a LIN protocol analyzer.
          2. Verify all transmitted/received frames use 0x55 Sync, valid PID (inc. parity), correct DLC, and LIN 2.0 Enhanced Checksum.
          3. Verify the measured baud rate is 19.2 kbit/s (within ±14% tolerance).
        Fail: |
          - Any frame field deviates from the LIN 2.0 specification.
          - Baud rate is outside the allowed tolerance.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0217_A_1.2"
      Title: "Verify Baud Rate Boundary Tolerance (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set tester baud rate to the minimum allowed (19.2k * 0.86). Verify communication is successful.
          2. Set tester baud rate to the maximum allowed (19.2k * 1.14). Verify communication is successful.
          3. Set tester baud rate just outside max (e.g., 19.2k * 1.15). Verify communication fails.
        Fail: |
          - Communication fails at the boundaries (Min/Max).
          - Communication succeeds outside the boundaries.

requirement: "The system (as a LIN slave) shall detect and discard any received LIN frame that fails the LIN 2.0 Enhanced Checksum validation
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0217_A_2.1"
      Title: "Verify Checksum Error Rejection (Negative Test)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Identify a LIN message that triggers a system action (e.g., 'Turn on Light').
          2. Send this message with a valid payload but an intentionally corrupted Enhanced Checksum.
          3. Verify the system does *not* perform the action (i.e., the light does *not* turn on).
          4. Verify the system does not crash or enter an error state.
        Fail: |
          - The system accepts the corrupted frame and performs the action.
          - The system crashes or resets.

requirement: "The system's LIN interface shall support Slave Node Position Detection (SNPD) for auto-addressing
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0217_A_3.1"
      Title: "Verify successful SNPD auto-addressing"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Connect the system (ECU) in a network with a LIN Master simulating the SNPD sequence.
          2. Initiate the auto-addressing sequence.
          3. Verify the ECU correctly follows the SNPD logic and accepts the new NAD assigned by the Master.
          4. Send a request to the new NAD; verify the ECU responds.
        Fail: |
          - The ECU fails to auto-address.
          - The ECU does not respond to its newly assigned NAD.

requirement: "The total duration of consecutive NRC $78 transmissions for a single diagnostic request SHALL NOT exceed 10 seconds. If the task is not completed within this limit, the system SHALL return NRC $10 (<SIG>) and clear the diagnostic buffer
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0224.1"
      Title: "Verify P2-to-P2* Transition and Final Response"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a diagnostic task requiring 100 ms.
          2. Verify NRC $78 is received <= 50 ms.
          3. Verify the final positive response is received between 50 ms and 5000 ms post-NRC $78.
        Fail: |
          - No NRC $78 sent at 50ms deadline, or no final response follows NRC $78.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0224.2"
      Title: "Verify Clean Termination within P2 Boundary"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger task requiring 30 ms.
          2. Verify direct positive response received within 50 ms.
          3. Confirm NO NRC $78 is transmitted.
        Fail: |
          - NRC $78 is sent unnecessarily, or response > 50 ms.

requirement: "The system shall transmit the LIN message '<SIG_293>' (8-byte payload) with Byte 7 (index 7) containing the calculated CRC-8 checksum of Bytes 0-6 (index 0-6)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0226.1"
      Title: "Verify CRC-8 checksum is placed in Byte 7 (index 7)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Configure the system to transmit '<SIG_293>'.
          2. Capture the transmitted LIN frame.
          3. Confirm the payload contains exactly 8 bytes (B0...B7).
          4. Manually compute the expected CRC-8 using Bytes 0-6 as input.
          5. Verify that Byte 7 (index 7) of the captured frame exactly matches the expected CRC-8.
        Fail: |
          - The '<SIG_293>' message does not contain 8 bytes.
          - Byte 7 (index 7) does not equal the correctly computed CRC-8 of Bytes 0-6.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0226.2"
      Title: "Verify correct CRC-8 placement under boundary data conditions (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Transmit '<SIG_293>' with Bytes 0-6 set to all zeros (0x00).
          2. Capture the frame; verify Byte 7 (index 7) equals the expected CRC (e.g., 0x00).
          3. Transmit '<SIG_293>' with Bytes 0-6 set to all ones (0xFF).
          4. Capture the frame; verify Byte 7 (index 7) equals the expected CRC (e.g., 0x3C).
        Fail: |
          - For all-zero payload (B0-B6), Byte 7 (index 7) is not the correct CRC.
          - For all-one payload (B0-B6), Byte 7 (index 7) is not the correct CRC.

requirement: "[Variant: NXP Microcontroller] The system shall deactivate the 'Under Voltage Fault' when the KL30 voltage rises strictly above the upper tolerance limit of the threshold (8.3 V + 5% = 8.715 V)
golden_vc:

      Title: "Verify Deactivation above Upper Tolerance (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Ensure 'Under Voltage Fault' is currently Active.
          2. Increase KL30 voltage to $8.72\text{ V}$ (Just above $8.3\text{V} + 5\%$).
          3. Verify that the 'Under Voltage Fault' status changes to Deactivated.
        Fail: |

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0235_B_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Fault Persistence below Lower Tolerance (Negative)"

      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Ensure 'Under Voltage Fault' is currently Active.
          2. Set KL30 voltage to $7.88\text{ V}$ (Just below $8.3\text{V} - 5\%$).
          3. Verify that the 'Under Voltage Fault' status remains Active.
        Fail: |
          - Fault deactivates when voltage is $< 7.885\text{ V}$.

requirement: "The system shall deactivate the 'Over Voltage Fault' (Heal) if the KL30 voltage remains continuously below 16.7 V (±5% tolerance, i.e., $\le 15.865\text{V}$) for a <SIG> duration of at least 50 ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0236_B_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Healing Logic (Positive Boundary)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Over Voltage Fault is Active.
          2. Set KL30 voltage to $15.86\text{V}$ (Valid) and maintain for $60\text{ms}$ ($\ge 50\text{ms}$ <SIG>).
          3. Verify that the Over Voltage Fault status transitions to Inactive (Clears).

          2. Set KL30 voltage to $15.86\text{V}$ (Valid) but only for $49\text{ms}$ ($< 50\text{ms}$ <SIG>).
          3. Verify the Over Voltage Fault remains Active.
        Fail: |
          - Fault clears prematurely (before $50\text{ms}$ elapsed).

requirement: "If a 'Rain Sensor <SIG> Fault' (detected via LIN Diagnostic Frame or internal HW monitoring) is active, the system shall set the LIN signal '<SIG_90>' to value 15 (Invalid/Error) and register the corresponding Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC)

requirement: "The System shall set the '<SIG_90>' signal value to 15 within 100 ms upon detection of any '<SIG_238>' (including internal parity errors or communication bus faults)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0242_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Signal Substitution on ASIC Hardware Error"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject a hardware fault into the ASIC (e.g., via debugger or hardware pins) to trigger the '<SIG_238>' internal flag.
          2. Monitor the '<SIG_90>' signal on the vehicle communication bus.
          3. Verify that '<SIG_90>' transitions to exactly 15 within 100 ms of fault detection.
          4. Maintain the fault and verify the value remains constant at 15.
        Fail: |
          - '<SIG_90>' does not transition to 15 within 100 ms.
          - The signal value remains at its pre-fault state or transitions to an undefined/incorrect value.
          - The system fails to register the ASIC error in the internal diagnostic buffer.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0242_B.2"
      Title: "Verify Signal Integrity (No False Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Operate the system under nominal conditions (no ASIC hardware errors present).
          2. Monitor '<SIG_90>' for 5 seconds during standard functional operations.
          3. Verify '<SIG_90>' follows its functional logic and never defaults to 15 unless the functional input specifically requires it.
        Fail: |
          - '<SIG_90>' defaults to 15 without a corresponding ASIC hardware error.

requirement: "The system design shall ensure Freedom From Interference (FFI) such that single-point electrical faults (Short-to-Ground, Short-to-Battery, Open Circuit) within the Light Sensor interface do not propagate to or degrade the performance of the Rain, Solar, or Humidity sensors
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0246.1"
      Title: "Verify FFI against Electrical Shorts (Hardware Isolation)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Establish nominal operation for all sensors (Rain, Light, Solar, Humidity).
          2. Inject a hard Short-to-Ground on the Light Sensor signal line (or power pin).
          3. Monitor the outputs of Rain, Solar, and Humidity sensors.
          4. Verify these sensors continue to update with valid data within specified tolerance (proving electrical isolation/buffering prevents shared rail collapse).
          5. Repeat with Short-to-Battery (e.g., $12\text{V}/5\text{V}$).
        Fail: |
          - Shared power rail collapses, causing all sensors to fail.
          - Shared ADC saturates, affecting measurements of other sensors.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0246.2"
      Title: "Verify FFI against Data/Logic <SIG> (Software Isolation)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject an Open Circuit or "Stuck-at" fault on the Light Sensor data line.
          2. Verify that the software driver handles the timeout/error for the Light Sensor *without* blocking the processing loop for Rain/Solar/Humidity sensors.
          3. Confirm update rates for other sensors remain unaffected.
        Fail: |
          - Software hangs or cycle time increases due to waiting for the faulty Light Sensor, delaying other sensor updates.
