- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0484.1"
      Title: "Verify Healing Counter Decrement and Persistence"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set <SIG> = 5. Perform a full cycle (Run > 5s, <SIG>=0, <SIG>). 
          2. Trigger <SIG_125>. 
          3. Verify <SIG> == 4.
          4. Force Reset. Read NVM. Verify Value == 4.
        Fail: |
          - Counter fails to decrement or fails to persist in NVM after reset.

requirement: "The ESCL shall detect a '<SIG_73>' on the '<SIG_74>' signal and set the Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) '0x9000A64' within 200 ms of fault confirmation, in accordance with the [P965 ESL Diagnosis Specification]
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0487.1"
      Title: "Verify DTC 0x9000A64 Triggering (Plausibility Fault Injection)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject an implausible signal state for '<SIG_74>' (e.g., reserved value or sequence error as per P965).
          2. Maintain the fault condition to exceed the defined debouncing/confirmation time.
          3. Verify via UDS Service 0x19 that DTC '0x9000A64' is stored in Event Memory.
          4. Confirm transition occurs within 200 ms post-confirmation.
          5. Verify status bits (<SIG>, <SIG>) match ISO 14229-1 expectations.
        Fail: |
          - DTC 0x9000A64 is not recorded in DEM.
          - DTC status bits are incorrect (e.g., Bit 3 '<SIG>' is not set).
          - Fault detection latency exceeds 200 ms plus the defined debouncing time.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0487.2"
      Title: "Verify DTC Quiescence (Nominal Signal Robustness)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Provide valid and plausible '<SIG_74>' signals according to the interface specification.
          2. Monitor the ESCL DEM for a continuous duration of 10 seconds.
          3. Confirm that DTC '0x9000A64' is not present and no status bits are active.
        Fail: |
          - DTC 0x9000A64 is erroneously set despite plausible input.
          - False positive detection occurs during nominal signal transitions.

requirement: "The System shall set the Diagnostic Trouble Code '<SIG_234>' (U0123) within 1000 ms upon detecting the '<SIG_235>' condition (Internal Fault ID: 0x901486) from the Braking System Module (BSM)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0490.1"
      Title: "Verify DTC U0123 Triggering (Signal Invalid)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Establish nominal communication between BSM and ESCL.
          2. Force BSM to transmit '<SIG_41>' with '<SIG_236>' status (or data outside defined validity range).
          3. Maintain this condition for > 1000 ms.
          4. Access ESCL Diagnostic Memory via UDS.
          5. Verify '<SIG_234>' (U0123) is status 'Confirmed' (Bit 3 set).
          6. Verify status bits comply with ISO 14229-1 (e.g., <SIG> = 1).
        Fail: |
          - DTC U0123 is not set after 1000 ms of invalid signal.
          - Wrong DTC is recorded.
          - Status bits indicate 'Passed' or 'Not Tested'.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0490.2"
      Title: "Verify DTC Quiescence (Valid Signal)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Transmit valid '<SIG_41>' data (valid range and '<SIG_354>' status) from BSM.
          2. Monitor ESCL Diagnostic Memory for 10 seconds.
          3. Verify '<SIG_234>' (U0123) is NOT set (<SIG> bit = 0).
        Fail: |
          - DTC U0123 is logged while signal is valid.

requirement: "The System shall update the '<SIG_226>' Status Mask based on the '<SIG_227>' (SYRS.0498_A/B). 1. Set: When '<SIG_227>' is TRUE, Set Bit 0 (<SIG>) = 1. 2. Clear: When '<SIG_227>' is FALSE, Set Bit 0 (<SIG>) = 0
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0498_C.1"
      Title: "Verify DTC Status Mapping"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Integration Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Toggle '<SIG_227>' ON and OFF.
          2. Verify Bit 0 of '<SIG_226>' follows the state synchronously.
        Fail: |
          - Bit 0 status does not match internal event.

requirement: "The ESCL shall reduce the aggregated payload size of its transmitted application messages (Tx) by at least 20% compared to the defined baseline payload size (<SIG_5>) under normal operating conditions
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0503.1"
      Title: "Verify Payload Reduction on ESCL Transmitted Messages (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Establish nominal operating conditions.
          2. Capture and log all CAN frames transmitted by the ESCL for a 60-second duration.
          3. Calculate the ESCL's total transmitted payload (<SIG_6>).
          4. Obtain the documented baseline payload size (<SIG_5>).
          5. Verify the reduction is at least 20%: (<SIG_5> - <SIG_6>) / <SIG_5> ≥ 0.20.
        Fail: |
          - Calculated payload reduction is less than 20%.
          - Inaccurate logging prevents calculation.

requirement: "The transition to '<SIG_219>' shall be inhibited if the '<SIG_41>' is > 0 km/h. In this case, the system SHALL reject the request with NRC $22 (ConditionsNotCorrect)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0507.1"
      Title: "Verify Programming Session Response and Timing Parameters"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Precondition: Vehicle Speed = 0. Send $10 02.
          2. Verify Response Header = 50 02.
          3. Confirm P2 (Byte 2-3) = 0x0032 and P2* (Byte 4-5) = 0x01F4.
          4. Measure Latency: Confirm <= 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Incorrect P2/P2* values, or response time > 50 ms.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0507.2"
      Title: "Verify Session Rejection under Safety Preconditions"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Simulate Vehicle Speed = 20 km/h. Send $10 02.
          2. Verify Negative Response: 7F 10 22.
        Fail: |
          - ECU allows session transition while vehicle is moving.

requirement: "The ESCL shall implement UDS Service 0x10 (DiagnosticSessionControl) with sub-function 0x40 (<SIG> Session), and respond with the exact byte sequence: 0x50 0x40 0x00 0x32 0x01 0xF4
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0509_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Protocol Format and Fixed Data Content (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send UDS request '10 40' to the ESCL.
          2. Confirm the ESCL responds with the exact 6-byte sequence: 0x50 0x40 0x00 0x32 0x01 0xF4.
          3. Verify the embedded timing parameters (0x0032 and 0x01F4) are correctly encoded within the response payload.
        Fail: |
          - The response byte sequence differs from the required 6-byte sequence.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0509_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Rejection of Unsupported Session Transitions (Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. While in the $40$ Session, send a request to transition to an unsupported/undefined session (e.g., '10 FF').
          2. Verify the ESCL responds with NRC 0x12 (<SIG>).
        Fail: |
          - The ESCL accepts the invalid session transition.

requirement: "In non-default sessions ($02, $03), the system shall monitor the <SIG> timer (Config: 5000 ms). If no diagnostic request (including $3E 80) is received within 5000 ms, the system SHALL automatically revert to 'Default Session' ($01) and reset all active security authorizations
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0510.1"
      Title: "Verify <SIG> Timeout and Automatic Reversion"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Transition to $03. Stop all communication.
          2. Monitor bus for 5000 ms.
          3. Verify that after 5000ms + 50ms tolerance, a SID $22 request returns NRC $33 or session-restricted status.
        Fail: |
          - ECU fails to revert to $01 or reverts prematurely (< 5000 ms).

requirement: "The ESCL shall implement UDS Service 0x11 (ECU Reset), supporting the '<SIG>' sub-function (0x01), and correctly send a positive response (0x51 0x01) for valid requests
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0515_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Positive Protocol Response and Reset Action"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send UDS request '11 01' (<SIG>).
          2. Verify ESCL responds with '51 01'.
          3. Verify the ECU immediately initiates a hard reset sequence.
        Fail: |
          - ECU responds with Negative Response or incorrect SID (not 0x51).
          - ECU fails to initiate hard reset after sending 0x51.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0515_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Negative Response for Unsupported Sub-function"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send UDS request '11 FF' (unsupported sub-function).
          2. Verify ESCL responds with Negative Response Code (NRC) 0x12 (<SIG>).
        Fail: |
          - ECU returns a positive response (0x51) or incorrect NRC.

requirement: "The system shall respond to $19 06 requests within <SIG_40> (50 ms). If the requested DTC is not stored or the <SIG> is not supported, the system shall return NRC $31 (RequestOutOfRange)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0519_B.1"
      Title: "Verify <SIG> Data Record Structure and <SIG> Logic"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a specific Diagnostic Event (DTC) to generate an <SIG> Data Record.
          2. Request <SIG> Data via UDS Service 0x19 0x06 (<SIG>).
          3. Verify that the response contains RDI $6080.
          4. Increment the event occurrence (e.g., re-trigger fault) and verify RDI $6080 increments accordingly as a non-negative integer.
        Fail: |
          - RDI $6080 is missing from the record payload.
          - The value of RDI $6080 does not increment or contains invalid data types.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0519_B.2"
      Title: "Verify Fixed Value for Warning Lamp Cycles (RDI $6081)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a Diagnostic Event and retrieve the <SIG> Data Record via UDS 0x19 0x06.
          2. Locate the data bytes corresponding to RDI $6081.
          3. Confirm the value is exactly 0x00.
        Fail: |
          - RDI $6081 is missing from the <SIG> Data Record.
          - The value of RDI $6081 is non-zero (indicating failed hardcoding of the fixed value).

requirement: "The ESCL shall support reading multiple Data Identifiers (DIDs) via UDS Service 0x22, aggregating the responses into a single positive message, provided the total data payload does not exceed the maximum response capacity (<SIG_53>, e.g., 258 bytes)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0524_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Successful Aggregation and Data Order (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a $22 request [<SIG_54>, <SIG_55>, <SIG_56>] where total data length < 258 bytes.
          2. Verify the response is a single positive message (SID $62).
          3. **CRITICAL:** Verify the data payload contains [<SIG_323>, <SIG_324>, <SIG_325>] in the exact order requested.
          4. Verify the total length is correct.
        Fail: |
          - Response is negative or truncated.
          - <SIG> data is returned in an incorrect sequence.

requirement: "The system shall respond to $22 requests within <SIG_40> (50 ms). For boundary-case multi-DID requests (Length = 258 bytes), the system SHALL ensure data integrity across all transport layer segments
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0524.1"
      Title: "Verify NRC 14 for Overflowing Multi-DID Requests"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send $22 with DIDs totalizing a 259-byte response (inc. SID/DID echo).
          2. Verify Negative Response: $7F 22 14.
          3. Measure Latency: Confirm <= 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - System returns NRC 31, or allows response > 258 bytes.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0524.2"
      Title: "Verify Integrity at Maximum Buffer Boundary (258 bytes)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send $22 with DIDs totalizing exactly a 258-byte response.
          2. Confirm Positive Response $62.
          3. Verify all data bytes match the internal NVM/RAM values.
        Fail: |
          - System returns NRC 14 for 258-byte request, or data is corrupted.

requirement: "The system shall respond to DID $1002 within <SIG_40> (50 ms). If the source CAN signal '<SIG_68>' is unavailable (Bus-Off or Timeout > 500ms), the system SHALL return NRC $22 (ConditionsNotCorrect)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0526.1"
      Title: "Verify DID $1002 Response and Signal Mapping"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject CAN signal <SIG_68> = 100 km/h.
          2. Send UDS request: $22 10 02.
          3. Verify Positive Response: $62 10 02 64 (0x64 = 100).
          4. Confirm latency <= 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Incorrect SID/DID echo, or value mismatch.

requirement: "The ESCL shall respond to the UDS request '$22 1032' with a positive response ($62 10 32) followed by the Steering Column States Byte. The Motor Command (2-bit) field shall be set to <SIG_212> → 0x00 or <SIG_213> → 0x01. The Motor Feedback (2-bit) field shall be set to <SIG_188> → 0x00, <SIG_298> → 0x01, or <SIG_85> → 0x02
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0531_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Motor Command Field Encoding and Reserved States (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set <SIG>.Cmd to <SIG_212>. Verify Motor Command field (Bits [7:6]) = 0x00.
          2. Set <SIG>.Cmd to <SIG_213>. Verify Motor Command field = 0x01.
          3. Set internal command to the Reserved state 0x02. Verify Motor Command field = 0x02 (or as defined by implementation).
          4. Verify Motor Command field never reports 0x03 (if 0x03 is permanently reserved).
        Fail: |
          - Command field encoding does not match specified values.
          - Command field reports an unspecified value (e.g., 0x03).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0531_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Motor Feedback Field Encoding and Reserved State (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set internal status (<SIG_188>, <SIG_298>, <SIG_85>) individually.
          2. Verify Motor Feedback field (Bits [5:4]) = 0x00, 0x01, and 0x02 respectively.
          3. Verify Motor Feedback field never reports 0x03.
        Fail: |
          - Feedback encoding does not match specified values (0x00, 0x01, 0x02).
          - Feedback field reports 0x03.

requirement: "The ESCL shall respond to the UDS request '22 1032' within 50 ms (<SIG_47>) of receiving the valid request
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0531_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Response Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send UDS request '22 1032' (Time T0).
          2. Measure Time T1 when the positive response begins (0x62).
          3. Verify Delta (T1 - T0) ≤ 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Response latency exceeds 50 ms.

requirement: "The system shall respond to the $200A request within <SIG_40> (50 ms). If the NVM data integrity check (CRC-8) fails for the counter, the system SHALL return NRC $72 (GeneralProgrammingFailure) and reset the counter to a default value of 0x00
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0537.1"
      Title: "Verify Counter Increment and NVM Persistence"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Read DID $200A (Value V1).
          2. Transition <SIG_210> OFF -> ON. Wait 600 ms.
          3. Abruptly remove power (simulating glitch). 
          4. Restore power and Read DID $200A. Confirm Value = V1 + 1.
        Fail: |
          - Counter fails to persist after power loss or increments incorrectly.

requirement: "The ESCL shall respond to RDI $200B with a 4-byte value encoded in Motorola (Big-Endian) format, representing the system uptime or timestamp in minutes
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0538_C_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Response Format and Endianness (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a diagnostic request for RDI $200B.
          2. Capture the response payload.
          3. Verify the payload length is exactly 4 bytes.
          4. Verify the byte order is Big-Endian (Motorola).
        Fail: |
          - Response length is incorrect.
          - Byte order is incorrect (Little-Endian).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0538_C_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Rejection of Invalid/Unsupported RDI (Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a diagnostic request with an unsupported RDI value (e.g., $200C).
          2. Verify ESCL responds with a negative response code (NRC 0x12 or 0x31).
        Fail: |
          - ESCL returns a positive response for an unsupported DID.

requirement: "The System shall populate the response data for Data Identifier (DID) '0x200C' with the value '0x0000' (default placeholder) upon receiving a UDS ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) request, provided no Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) snapshot records are currently stored in the Event Memory
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0539_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Default Snapshot Value (Empty Memory)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Perform a 'ClearDiagnosticInformation' (0x14) command to ensure the DEM snapshot memory is empty.
          2. Transmit UDS request: 'ReadDataByIdentifier' (0x22) for DID '0x200C'.
          3. Capture the positive response payload.
          4. Verify the data content for DID '0x200C' is exactly '0x0000'.
        Fail: |
          - Response data is not '0x0000' (e.g., contains random data or previous values).
          - System sends Negative Response Code (NRC) instead of positive response.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0539_B.2"
      Title: "Verify Data Presence (Non-Empty Memory)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Induce a fault condition that triggers a DTC storage with Snapshot Data.
          2. Transmit UDS request: 'ReadDataByIdentifier' (0x22) for DID '0x200C'.
          3. Verify the data content is NOT '0x0000' (should contain valid snapshot structure).
        Fail: |
          - Response data remains '0x0000' despite the presence of a stored snapshot.

requirement: "The ESCL shall respond to RDI $200C$ with a 2-byte value (Motorola format) representing the system uptime (<SIG_48>) in units where 1 LSB equals 15 seconds
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0539_C_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Format, Endianness, and Nominal Scaling (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Allow the system to run for a known duration (e.g., 30 minutes = 1800 seconds).
          2. Send RDI $200C$ request. Capture and decode the 2-byte response (Expected LSB value = 1800 / 15 = 120).
          3. Verify payload length is 2 bytes and encoded in Big-Endian (Motorola) format.
          4. Verify the decoded value is within ±1 LSB (±15 seconds) of the expected time.
        Fail: |
          - Byte order is incorrect.
          - Decoded value exceeds the ±15 seconds tolerance.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0539_C_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Boundary Values and Rollover (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Verify response is $0	ext{x}0000$ at system start (<SIG_48> = 0).
          2. Force the internal counter to the maximum value ($0	ext{<SIG>}$). Verify response is $0	ext{<SIG>}$.
          3. After $0	ext{<SIG>}$ is reached, verify the next recorded value rolls over to $0	ext{x}0000$ (proving correct 16-bit Rollover).
        Fail: |
          - Rollover fails (e.g., sticks at $0	ext{<SIG>}$ or provides an error code).

requirement: "The ESCL shall process the RDI $200C$ request and transmit the positive response within 50 ms (<SIG_47>) of receiving the valid request
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0539_C_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Response Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send RDI $200C$ request (Time T0).
          2. Measure Time T1 when the positive response begins.
          3. Verify Delta (T1 - T0) ≤ 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Latency exceeds 50 ms.

requirement: "The system shall respond to $2939 request within <SIG_40> (50 ms). If the '<SIG_63>' NVM integrity check (CRC-16) fails, the system SHALL return NRC $72 (GeneralProgrammingFailure) to inhibit the transmission of an incorrect state identifier
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0542.1"
      Title: "Verify Programming Status Mapping and Response ID"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Set ECU to 'Blank' condition (App Valid, Lock = False). 
          2. Send $22 29 39. Verify Response: $62 29 39 01.
          3. Measure Latency: Confirm <= 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Response SID != 0x62, or state byte does not match the actual physical lifecycle stage.

requirement: "The ESCL shall implement the 'Active Diagnostic Session' identifier (RDI $F186) and respond with the header $0\text{x}62\text{F}186$ followed by the single-byte session ID, mapped as: 0x01=Default, 0x02=Programming, 0x03=<SIG>, 0x40=<SIG>, 0x50=<SIG>, 0x60=<SIG>
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0543.1"
      Title: "Verify Session Code Mapping (Equivalence Class / Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Equivalence Class Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. For each of the six specified diagnostic sessions (0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60):
          	    a. Establish the session (via UDS 0x10).
          	    b. Send a UDS Read Data by Identifier (0x22) request with DID 0xF186.
          	    c. Verify the response is 0x62F186 followed by the single, correct session ID byte.
        Fail: |
          - Any session returns an incorrect session code byte (e.g., 0x03 is returned when in Programming session 0x02).
          - Response length is not exactly 3 bytes (SID, DID, Value).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0543.2"
      Title: "Verify Negative Response in <SIG> State (Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Place the ESCL in an undefined state (e.g., jump to a non-session handling address or during reset initialization).
          2. Send a UDS 0x22 request with DID 0xF186.
          3. Verify the ESCL responds with a negative response code (e.g., NRC 0x7F 'Service Not Supported in Active Session' or 0x11 'Session Not Active').
        Fail: |
          - ESCL returns a positive response (0x62F186) in an undefined session context.
          - ESCL crashes or hangs.

requirement: "The system shall respond to the $F182 request within <SIG_40> (50 ms). In case of NVM read failure, the system SHALL return NRC $72 (GeneralProgrammingFailure)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.0546.1"
      Title: "Verify DID $F182 Response ID and Hex Encoding"

      Pass_Fail_Criteria:

requirement: "The FES shall detect a '<SIG_249>' fault on any of the 9 '<SIG_250>' pins/traces. Upon detection, the system shall set the corresponding Diagnostic Event Status to 'FAILED' within 100 ms

          2. Verify that the '<SIG>' bit (Bit 0) for the corresponding DTC transitions to 0 after the defined healing cycle or debouncing time.
        Fail: |

requirement: "The FES shall discard all HMI user inputs (including Touchscreen, Hardkeys, and Rotary Knob events) while the Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) '<SIG>' status is 'Active

requirement: "If a '<SIG>' ($31 02) request is received for an RID that is currently not in 'ACTIVE' state, the system SHALL reject the request with NRC $24 (RequestSequenceError) to maintain state machine consistency

          2.  Send routine 0x1008 with an invalid command code (e.g., ''RESET'', empty
          	 payload, or malformed data).

          3.  Verify FES remains in ''lock'' state and returns a negative response
          	 code (e.g., 0x31 or 0x12 as per ISO 14229).

          '
        Fail: '-    FES changes state upon receiving invalid command.

          -    No negative response is returned.

          -    FES crashes or becomes unresponsive.'

requirement: The PWM luminance scaling factors shall have a range from 0 to 1 with a step size of 0.001 (0.1%). A scaling factor of 0 corresponds to a PWM duty cycle of 0%, and a scaling factor of 1 corresponds to a PWM duty cycle of 100%
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYS.1027.1
    Title: Verification of PWM luminance scaling factor range and mapping to duty cycle extremes
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Boundary Value Analysis
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 0.000 and measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        2. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle is 0% ± 0.1%.
        3. Set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 1.000 and measure the resulting PWM duty cycle.
        4. Verify that the measured PWM duty cycle is 100% ± 0.1%.
      Fail: |
        - Measured duty cycle at scaling factor 0.000 is not within [0.0%, 0.1%].
        - Measured duty cycle at scaling factor 1.000 is not within [99.9%, 100.0%].
- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYS.1027.2
    Title: Verification of PWM luminance scaling factor step resolution
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Boundary Value Analysis
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Configure the system to use a PWM luminance scaling factor of 0.500 and record the output duty cycle D1.
        2. Increment the scaling factor by one step to 0.501 and record the new duty cycle D2.
        3. Calculate the difference $\Delta D = D2 - D1$.
        4. Verify that $\Delta D$ equals 0.1% ± 0.01% (i.e., 0.099% ≤ $\Delta D$ ≤ 0.101%).
      Fail: |
        - The observed duty cycle change $\Delta D$ is outside the tolerance [0.099%, 0.101%].
- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYS.1027.3
    Title: Verification of valid scaling factor input rejection beyond defined range
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Negative Testing
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Attempt to set the PWM luminance scaling factor to -0.001.
        2. Verify the system rejects the input or clamps it to 0.000, and logs an error or warning if applicable.
        3. Attempt to set the PWM luminance scaling factor to 1.001.
        4. Verify the system rejects the input or clamps it to 1.000, and logs an error or warning if applicable.
      Fail: |
        - The system accepts a scaling factor < 0.000 without rejection or clamping.
        - The system accepts a scaling factor > 1.000 without rejection or clamping.

requirement: "The stored reset event counters (Data Identifier <SIG_45>) shall be readable via the UDS Service 0x22 (Read Data By Identifier)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1035_D_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Counter Read and Value Match (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Trigger a known number of resets (e.g., 5) to set the counter to <SIG_46>.
          2. Send UDS request 0x22 with <SIG_45>.
          3. Verify ECU responds with 0x62 <SIG_45> and a data payload of the correct length (e.g., 4 bytes).
          4. Validate that the returned counter value matches <SIG_46> exactly (±0 counts).
        Fail: |
          - ECU responds with NRC or no response.
          - Returned data payload length is incorrect (e.g., not 4 bytes).
          - Returned counter value does not match <SIG_46>.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1035_D_A.2"

      Method:

        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:

          1. Send UDS request 0x22 with an invalid or unsupported DID (not mapped to counter).
          2. Confirm ECU responds with NRC 0x12 (<SIG>) or NRC 0x31 (<SIG>).
        Fail: |
          - ECU accepts the invalid DID (Positive Response).

requirement: "The ECU shall transmit the positive response for the RDI 0x22 request (SYRS.1035_D_A) within 50 ms (<SIG_47>)

requirement: "The FES display shall provide a pixel resolution of at least 400 pixels (Horizontal) x 400 pixels (Vertical)

          3. Confirm no scaling/aliasing artifacts that suggest a lower native resolution.
        Fail: |

requirement: "The 'TransferData' positive response ($76) shall include a 16-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) checksum, calculated using the CRC-16-CCITT algorithm over the entire response data field (<SIG>)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1074_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Checksum Format and Calculation (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a valid 'TransferData' (0x36) request.
          2. Capture the positive response (0x76).
          3. Verify the checksum field is present, occupying exactly 2 bytes (16 bits).
          4. Calculate the expected CRC-16-CCITT checksum for the response data and compare it to the received checksum value.
          5. Confirm the received checksum matches the expected calculated value.
        Fail: |
          - Checksum field length is incorrect.
          - Calculated checksum does not match received checksum.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1074_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Checksum Robustness at Data Length Boundaries (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a 'TransferData' request with minimum allowed payload size (e.g., 1 byte data).
          2. Send a 'TransferData' request with maximum allowed payload size (e.g., 255 bytes data).
          3. Verify that the 16-bit checksum is correctly calculated and present in the response for both minimum and maximum boundary payload sizes.
        Fail: |
          - Checksum calculation fails or is incorrect at boundary payload sizes.

requirement: "The 'PCBA ID' read by the system for the first hardware revision (<SIG_274>) shall be exactly 0x01

          2. Read the 'PCBA ID' via the defined diagnostic interface (e.g., UDS RDI 0xF1xx).
          3. Confirm the read value is exactly 0x01.
        Fail: |
          - The read 'PCBA ID' value is not equal to 0x01.
          - The ID is inaccessible or uninitialized.

          2. Read the 'PCBA ID' via the diagnostic interface.
          3. Confirm the read value is exactly 0x02 (i.e., the system is correctly reading the stored value, proving the mechanism is functional beyond the 0x01 boundary).
        Fail: |
          - The system incorrectly reports 0x01 or an invalid value, indicating the ID reading mechanism is hard-coded or faulty.

requirement: "The system shall store the 'Assembly ID' and 'Revision' within the 'Code Descriptor' non-volatile memory structure, making them readable via calibration/measurement interfaces (e.g., XCP or Debugger)

          3. Read the data at the 'Assembly ID' offset.

          2. Verify the value matches the expected revision of the flashed software (e.g., 0x01 for initial build).
        Fail: |
          - Revision field is not readable.
          - Value implies an incorrect version (mismatch with release notes).

requirement: "Once a '<SIG> Reset' fault is confirmed, the system shall transmit the '<SIG_300>' message with both signals (<SIG_301>, <SIG_302>) set to '1'. The first transmission shall occur within 10 ms of the completion of the Communication Stack initialization

requirement: "The system shall transmit the CAN signal '<SIG_119>' as a positive integer in the range [1, 32767], where the value represents the steering wheel angle during clockwise rotation, corresponding to 0.1° per LSB

requirement: "The System shall set the '<SIG_259>' fault status to 'Active' (<SIG> bit = 1) within 100 ms if the absolute difference between the '<SIG_260>' and the '<SIG_261>' (calculated from M2 sensor) is greater than or equal to [<SIG_365>] (5 degrees)

      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1091_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Fault Activation at Boundary (Difference >= 5 deg)"

        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject '<SIG_260>' and '<SIG_261>' signals such that |Actual - Expected| = 5.0 degrees.
          2. Monitor '<SIG_259>' via UDS Service 0x19 0x02.
          3. Verify '<SIG>' bit transitions to 1 within 100 ms.
        Fail: |

        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject signal values such that the difference is 4.9 degrees.
          2. Maintain this state for at least 300 ms (3x diagnostic cycles).
          3. Verify '<SIG_259>' status remains 'Inactive' (Bit 0 = 0).
        Fail: |

    - VC_Item:

          2. Adjust signals to reduce the difference to < 5.0 degrees (e.g., 0.0 degrees).
          3. Verify '<SIG>' bit transitions to 0 after the defined [<SIG_366>] period (e.g., 200 ms).
        Fail: |

requirement: "Upon ECU restart following an 'ECU Reset' (0x11) request, the diagnostic communication timeout (P2* Timer) shall be implicitly reset to its initial 50 ms value
golden_vc:

      Title: "Verify P2* Timeout Initialization and Boundary Precision (Positive BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Send a UDS 0x11 (ECU Reset) request to the ECU.
          2. After system restart, monitor the diagnostic communication bus.
          3. Send a diagnostic message just before $50\text{ ms}$ (e.g., $49.9\text{ ms}$) since the last valid frame. Verify the ECU responds.
          4. Send a diagnostic message just after $50\text{ ms}$ (e.g., $50.1\text{ ms}$). Verify the ECU times out (closes session or ignores).
          5. Confirm that the functional timeout value is exactly $50\text{ ms}$ ($\pm 1\text{ ms}$ tolerance).
        Fail: |
          - ECU rejects messages before $49.9\text{ ms}$ (Premature Timeout).
          - ECU accepts messages beyond $50.1\text{ ms}$ (Incorrect Initialization).

requirement: "The System shall latch the '<SIG_245>' status (<SIG> bit = 1) upon detection. This status shall remain latched for the entire duration of the current '<SIG_76>' and shall only be reset (<SIG> bit = 0) upon completion of a valid '<SIG_244>' transition
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1095_B.1"
      Title: "Verify ADC Calibration Error Latching (Same Drive Cycle)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: System is in a valid '<SIG_76>' (Ignition ON).
          2. Trigger an '<SIG_245>' (e.g., by overriding ADC calibration values via debugger or calibration tool).
          3. Verify via UDS Service 0x19 0x02 that DTC status bit 0 (<SIG>) is 1.
          4. Remove the error condition (restore valid calibration).
          5. Monitor the status for > 60 seconds while keeping Ignition ON.
          6. Verify Bit 0 remains 1 (latched state).
        Fail: |
          - Fault is not detected upon injection.
          - Fault status Bit 0 transitions to 0 before an ignition cycle occurs, even after the physical error is removed.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1095_B.2"
      Title: "Verify Deactivation Logic (Ignition Cycle Reset)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: '<SIG_245>' is latched (Bit 0 = 1) and the physical error is removed.
          2. Attempt to clear via UDS Service 0x14 (ClearDiagnosticInformation); verify status Bit 0 remains 1 (if the requirement forbids 0x14 clearing for this specific latch).
          3. Perform Ignition OFF.
          4. Wait for ECU power-down/EEPROM commit.
          5. Perform Ignition ON.
          6. Verify via UDS Service 0x19 0x02 that DTC status Bit 0 is now 0.
        Fail: |
          - Fault is cleared by a software command or reset without a physical ignition transition.
          - Fault remains latched (Bit 0 = 1) after a successful Ignition OFF/ON cycle.

requirement: "The updated DTC status and snapshots (Freeze Frames) shall be synchronized to NVM within 500ms of fault maturation

requirement: "The System shall set the '<SIG_121>' signal to 'ERROR' within 100 ms after the local input supply voltage remains below [<SIG_266>] (7.5 V) for a continuous duration of [<SIG_267>] (15 s)

        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a '<SIG_77>' (e.g., via hardware watchdog timeout or software trap).
          2. Verify via UDS Service 0x19 0x02 that the DTC status '<SIG>' (Bit 0) is 1.
          3. Maintain the system in the '<SIG_356>' state for 10 minutes.
          4. Periodically poll the DTC status and verify Bit 0 remains 1.
          5. Simulate various vehicle signals (e.g., Speed > 0, Engine Run) and verify the fault does not clear.
        Fail: |
          - The '<SIG_75>' status clears (Bit 0 transitions to 0) while Ignition remains ON.
          - The system fails to record the fault in the Event Memory after the reset occurs.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1106_C.2"
      Title: "Verify Deactivation Logic (Ignition Cycle Reset)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: '<SIG_75>' is latched (Bit 0 = 1).
          2. Execute an '<SIG_357>' (UDS 0x11 0x01) and '<SIG_358>' transitions; verify fault remains latched.
          3. Perform Ignition OFF.
          4. Wait for the defined power-down/soak time (e.g., 5 seconds).
          5. Perform Ignition ON.
          6. Verify via UDS Service 0x19 0x02 that the '<SIG>' bit (Bit 0) for the <SIG> Reset DTC is now 0.
        Fail: |
          - Fault is cleared by a soft reset (0x11) or session change without an ignition transition.
          - Fault remains latched (Bit 0 = 1) after a full Ignition OFF/ON cycle.

requirement: "When the physical position of the stalk changes, the SCCM shall transmit the corresponding updated state on the CAN bus within a maximum latency of 70 ms (Fault Reaction Time Interval)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1121.1"
      Title: "Verify Stalk Position Update Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a physical stalk position change (e.g., Left Turn activation) at Time $<SIG_59>$ (Moment of detection at SCCM input).
          2. Measure Time $<SIG_60>$ when the corresponding CAN message containing the updated stalk state is transmitted on the bus.
          3. Verify the measured latency ($<SIG_60> - <SIG_59>$) is $\le 70\text{ ms}$.
        Fail: |
          - Measured transmission delay exceeds $70\text{ ms}$ for any valid stalk position transition.
          - Transmitted CAN message does not reflect the actual stalk position change.

requirement: "The system shall set the CAN signal '<SIG_170>' to the value 'IDLE' whenever the turn indicator stalk is in the Neutral position or if no valid position is mechanically detected
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1124_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Default IDLE State at Neutral (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Power on the system.
          2. Ensure the turn indicator stalk is mechanically in the 'Neutral' position.
          3. Monitor '<SIG_170>'.
          4. Verify the signal value corresponds to 'IDLE'.
        Fail: |
          - Signal is not 'IDLE' (e.g., indicates Left or Right while in Neutral).
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1124_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Fallback to IDLE on Invalid Input (Robustness)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject an invalid electrical signal into the stalk input pin (e.g., ambiguous voltage between thresholds or open circuit if detectable).
          2. Monitor '<SIG_170>'.
          3. Verify the signal maintains or reverts to the 'IDLE' state.
        Fail: |
          - Signal indicates a valid turn state (Left/Right) based on noise/invalid input.
          - Signal value is undefined/corrupted.

requirement: "The system shall update the '<SIG_170>' CAN signal to reflect a new state (Valid Position or IDLE) within 50 ms of the physical stalk position change

"The system shall transmit the confirmed stalk status in the CAN/LIN signal '<SIG_170>'. 1. Value 0x0 (IDLE) if position is Neutral; 2. Value 0xF (Invalid) if sensor fault is detected. The transmission latency from status confirmation to bus output shall be $\le$ 80 ms
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1125.2"
      Title: "Verify Signal Mapping and Transmission Latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger confirmed IDLE state (Time T0).
          2. Monitor bus: Measure Time T1 when signal 0x0 is transmitted.
          3. Verify (T1 - T0) ≤ 80 ms.
          4. Inject sensor fault: Verify signal transitions to 0xF.
        Fail: |
          - Incorrect signal value or transmission latency post-confirmation > 80 ms.

requirement: "The SCCM left stalk shall mechanically return to the 'Neutral Position' (defined as 0° ± 1° angular displacement) when the actuation force is released
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1126_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Mechanical Return <SIG> (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Mount the stalk on a fixture with an angular position sensor.
          2. Deflect stalk to 'Left Turn' position. Release.
          3. Verify final resting position is within 0° ± 1°.
          4. Deflect stalk to 'Right Turn' position. Release.
          5. Verify final resting position is within 0° ± 1°.
        Fail: |
          - Stalk settles outside the ±1° tolerance band.
          - Stalk gets stuck before reaching neutral.

requirement: "The SCCM left stalk shall complete the mechanical return to the 'Neutral Position' (defined in SYRS.1126_A) within 500 ms of release
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1126_B.1"
      Title: "Verify Return Damping/Timing (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Setup high-speed camera or high-sample-rate position logger.
          2. Deflect stalk to maximum travel.
          3. Release stalk (Time $<SIG_59>$).
          4. Measure time ($<SIG_60>$) when stalk position enters and stays within the Neutral zone ($\pm 1^{\circ}$).
          5. Verify Delta ($<SIG_60> - <SIG_59>$) $\le 500\text{ ms}$.
        Fail: |
          - Return time exceeds $500\text{ ms}$ (over-damped or high friction).
          - Stalk oscillates in/out of neutral zone beyond $500\text{ ms}$ (under-damped).

requirement: "The system shall trigger an event-based transmission of the '<SIG_288>' message if the value of '<SIG_170>' changes after the 10ms <SIG> period
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1130_B_A.1"
      Title: "Verify transmission on valid post-<SIG> change (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Simulate a change in '<SIG_170>' (e.g., 0->1) that persists for >= 10ms.
          2. Verify that the '<SIG_288>' message is transmitted.
        Fail: |
          - No transmission occurs despite a valid post-<SIG> state change.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1130_B_A.2"
      Title: "Verify no transmission on transient pre-<SIG> change (Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Simulate a transient change (0->1->0) that reverts before 10ms elapses (e.g., pulse width 9ms).
          2. Verify that no '<SIG_288>' message is transmitted.
        Fail: |
          - A message is transmitted in response to a transient change < 10ms.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1130_B_A.3"
      Title: "Verify <SIG> timing boundary (BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Apply a status change with a duration of 9.9ms.
          2. Confirm no transmission occurs.
          3. Apply a status change with a duration of 10.0ms.
          4. Confirm a transmission *does* occur.
        Fail: |
          - Transmission occurs for 9.9ms duration.
          - No transmission occurs for 10.0ms duration.

requirement: "The system shall transmit the event-based '<SIG_288>' message (triggered by SYRS.1130_B_A) within 5ms of the post-<SIG> event
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1130_B_B.1"
      Title: "Verify transmission latency (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria:
        Pass: |
          1. Trigger a valid event transmission (per SYRS.1130_B_A, e.g., signal change > 10ms).
          2. Measure the latency between the 10ms <SIG> point (<SIG_289>) and the start of the CAN frame transmission (<SIG_290>).
          3. Verify Latency (<SIG_290> - <SIG_289>) is ≤ 5ms.
        Fail: |
          - Measured latency is > 5ms.

requirement: "The SCCM left stalk mechanism shall mechanically restrict travel in the 'Right Turn' direction, engaging the end-stop (Position P2) at an angular displacement of 4° ± 2° relative to neutral
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1132_B.1"
      Title: "Verify End-Stop Angle at Nominal Force (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Mount the SCCM on a test fixture with angular measurement.
          2. Actuate the stalk to the 'Right Turn' direction using the nominal actuation force (e.g., $5\text{N}$ or as specified).
          3. Record the angular position where the stalk comes to rest against the stop.
          4. Verify the angle is within [$2.0^{\circ}, 6.0^{\circ}$].
        Fail: |
          - Angle is outside the $2^{\circ} - 6^{\circ}$ range.
          - Stalk does not reach a distinct mechanical stop.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1132_B.2"
      Title: "Verify End-Stop Rigidity (Robustness)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Stress Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Apply an excessive actuation force (e.g., $1.5\times$ Nominal Force) to the stalk against the Right Turn end-stop.
          2. Measure the angular displacement under load.
          3. Verify the angle does not exceed the upper tolerance limit ($6.0^{\circ}$) significantly (e.g., stays $< 6.5^{\circ}$), confirming the stop is rigid and not spongy.
        Fail: |
          - Stalk pushes past the end-stop (angle $> 6.5^{\circ}$) or mechanical failure occurs.

requirement: "The SCCM left stalk system shall detect signal failures (Short Circuit, Open Circuit, or <SIG> Value) and transition to the defined Safe State (e.g., 'Invalid' signal status) within the Fault Reaction Time Interval (FRTI) derived from ASIL B goals
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1136.1"
      Title: "Verify Safe State Transition on Fault Injection (Positive)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Power on the system in normal operation.
          2. Inject a physical fault into the Left Stalk signal path (e.g., disconnect Pin/Open Circuit).
          3. Monitor the system output (CAN Signal/Status).
          4. Verify the system transitions to the 'Safe State' (e.g., Signal Value = 'Invalid/SNA' or Default Value).
        Fail: |
          - System continues to output the last valid value (frozen) or erratic values.
          - System does not enter Safe State.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1136.2"
      Title: "Verify Fault Reaction Time Interval (Performance)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Performance Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Setup high-speed logger.
          2. Inject a fault (e.g., Short to Ground) at Time $T0$.
          3. Measure Time $T1$ when the system output reflects the 'Safe State'.
          4. Verify $\Delta (T1 - T0) \le \text{FRTI}$ (e.g., $100\text{ ms}$ or as defined in Safety Manual).
        Fail: |
          - Reaction time exceeds the required FRTI.

requirement: "The System shall set the '<SIG>' (<SIG_256>) fault to 'Active' (<SIG> bit = 1) within 100 ms if the '<SIG_257>' exceeds the threshold of [<SIG_258>] (3.0 degrees/ms)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1140_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Fault Activation at Upper Boundary (Positive Logic)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject a '<SIG_257>' input of 3.1 degrees/ms (Threshold + 0.1).
          2. Monitor the '<SIG>' (<SIG_256>) status via UDS Service 0x19 0x02.
          3. Verify the '<SIG>' bit (Bit 0) transitions to 1 within 100 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Fault status remains 'Inactive' (Bit 0 = 0) despite speed > 3.0 degrees/ms.
          - Reporting latency exceeds 100 ms.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1140_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Fault Inactivity at Boundary (Negative Logic)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject a '<SIG_257>' input of exactly 3.0 degrees/ms.
          2. Maintain this input for 500 ms.
          3. Verify the '<SIG>' (<SIG_256>) status remains 'Inactive' (Bit 0 = 0).
        Fail: |
          - Fault is erroneously triggered (False Positive) when speed is exactly on the limit.

    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1140_A.3"
      Title: "Verify Signal <SIG> (Self-Healing Logic)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Fault is active (Speed > 3.0).
          2. Reduce '<SIG_257>' to 2.0 degrees/ms (Nominal).
          3. Verify the '<SIG>' bit transitions to 0 after the defined debouncing/healing time.
        Fail: |
          - Fault remains latched as 'Active' after signal returns to nominal range.

requirement: "Upon receiving the UDS service $0401 ('Clear Overrotation Flag') request, the system shall clear Alert 506516 and its associated max/min angle data from the Alert Log, PROVIDED that the 'ASAS Angle' is within the valid range (<SIG_211>)
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157_A.1"
      Title: "Verify Successful Clearing at Boundary Conditions (Positive BVA)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Boundary Value Analysis"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Alert 506516 is Active.
          2. Set the ASAS angle to the MINIMUM valid value (Lower Bound of <SIG_211>).
          3. Send UDS request $0401$.
          4. Confirm ECU responds with positive response ($4401) and Alert 506516 is CLEARED.
          5. Repeat steps 1-4 with the ASAS angle set to the MAXIMUM valid value (Upper Bound of <SIG_211>).
        Fail: |
          - Clearing fails (Alert persists) at either the minimum or maximum valid angle boundary.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157_A.2"
      Title: "Verify Rejection when Precondition Fails (Negative)"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Negative Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Pre-condition: Alert 506516 is Active.
          2. Set the ASAS angle to a value OUTSIDE the valid range (e.g., Min - 1°).
          3. Send UDS service request $0401$.
          4. Confirm ECU responds with a negative response code (NRC 0x22, Conditions Not Correct).
          5. Verify that Alert 506516 remains in the Alert Log.
        Fail: |
          - ECU responds with a positive response ($4401).
          - Alert is cleared despite the invalid precondition.
    - VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157_A.3"
      Title: "Verify Associated Data Clearance"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Execute a successful clearing sequence (as per VC.1).
          2. Read the Alert Log memory area.
          3. Confirm that the associated maximum and minimum angle data recorded with Alert 506516 are ALSO no longer present.
        Fail: |
          - Max/Min angle data remains in the log after the fault itself is cleared.

requirement: "Upon successful execution of the 'Data Clear' procedure (per SYRS.1157_A), the DCM (Diagnostic Communication Manager) shall transmit a Positive Response ($44) to the tester. 1. Response Timing: The transmission shall occur within the configured <SIG_40> (50 ms) after the internal clear confirmation; 2. Data Integrity: All DTCs and Snapshot data specified in the request range shall be verified as erased prior to response
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157.1"
      Title: "Verify Service $04 Positive Response and Timing"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Positive Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Inject active DTCs; Trigger $04 FF FF FF. 
          2. Capture bus: Confirm Positive Response = $44.
          3. Measure Latency (End of request to SOF of $44): Verify <= 50 ms.
        Fail: |
          - Response ID is not $44, or latency exceeds P2 limit.

requirement: "If the NVM clearing process fails due to a hardware driver error or busy state, the system shall return a Negative Response with NRC $72 (GeneralProgrammingFailure) or NRC $21 (BusyRepeatRequest) instead of $44
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157.2"
      Title: "Verify NRC Response on Clearance Failure"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Simulate NVM Write/Erase Error. 
          2. Send $04 FF FF FF. 
          3. Verify response: $7F 04 72.
        Fail: |
          - System erroneously sends $44 despite internal failure.

requirement: "If the '<SIG_216>' calibration parameter in NVM is blank (0xFFFF) or invalid, the system shall treat the ASAS angle as 'invalid' and reject the $04 request with NRC $31 (RequestOutOfRange) to distinguish it from a situational range violation
golden_vc:
- VC_Item:
      VC_ID: "VC_SYS.1157.1"
      Title: "Verify Standard NRC Response for Range/Calibration <SIG>"
      Method:
        Type: "Dynamic"
        Technique: "Fault Injection Testing"
      Pass_Fail_Criteria: 
        Pass: |
          1. Scenario A: Set ASAS = 600°. Send $04 FF FF FF. Verify Response: $7F 04 22.
          2. Scenario B: Corrupt NVM '<SIG_216>'. Send $04 FF FF FF. Verify Response: $7F 04 31.
        Fail: |
          - System returns a positive response, a 1-byte custom code, or an incorrect NRC.
